summary: Trillion Energy International Inc. filed a Form 6-K providing a corporate update, including its expected closing of a previously announced private placement around May 22, 2026, and its status regarding the M47 farm-in obligation to earn a 29% participating interest. The update also covers the delay in filing its annual financial statements and the existence of a management cease trade order (MCTO). No definitive special-situation transaction (e.g., acquisition, tender offer, spin-off) is announced; the filing is a routine operational and compliance update. It is a report of a foreign private issuer with no actionable special event.
